sources.title: Djinni — generated cross-language interfaces
sources.version_or_date: Live archived master README; mentions introduction at CppCon 2014.
sources.sections_read: Introduction, main features, IDL examples, generated code, identifier formatting, historical talk links.
sources.confirmed: Djinni generates corresponding interfaces for C++, Java, and Objective-C from shared declarations and supports identifier-format conversions. Its current README is not a dated version of every described feature.
sources.limits: Targets C++ with Java or Objective-C and requires an interface description; arbitrary imported methods need importer integration or a new generator.
